AC amendment (gap G10): T5 docs scope. T5 currently depends on T1 only for parallel-dispatch. The docs MUST cover behavior contributed by T2/T3/T4 (quarantine suppression, repair_property failure path). Two options:
1. Bump T5 deps to {T1, T2, T3, T4} — sequential, accurate.
2. Restrict T5 scope to ONLY the T1 invariant + Mode A/B taxonomy; defer applier/differ docs to a follow-up.
Recommend option 1 for completeness — the docs are operator-facing and must describe what they'll actually see in production. Story closure should re-link T5 → T4 if option 1 is taken.
